sources.note: Grammar appendix 'La ortografía mixteca' (pp. 137-138) covers alphabet, glottal stop, six vowels, nasalization and tone ('El mixteco es un idioma tonal.. Hay tres niveles de tono en el mixteco de Chayuco', p. 138); no mention of stress/acento anywhere in the volume (full-scanned a full-text search for stress/accent acento/acentu/stress = 0 hits; p. 138 verified against page image).
